clue.text: Master mariner's first degree student is a warm-blooded creature

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a master's title

indicators.note: first means only the opening letter of mariner's is taken

parts.note: MA is a university degree, Master of Arts
L is a learner, the student driver's plate

explanation.surface: A ship's captain's first qualification makes him a warm-blooded beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Master mariner' looks like one title, but it splits: Master gives MA and 'first' takes the M of mariner's.
explanation.definitionFit: Mammals are the animal class that keep a constant body heat.

clue.text: The stage set for defender to fall

parts.note: a back is a defending player in football or rugby
to drop is to fall

explanation.surface: A footballer is primed to go down theatrically.
explanation.definitionFit: A painted cloth hung at the rear of a theatre forms the scenery behind the actors.

clue.text: Tuna scarce? Perhaps — and lobster, for example

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters might form something else once rearranged

explanation.surface: A fishmonger worries that tuna is in short supply, so offers lobster instead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' signals an anagram of TUNA SCARCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Lobsters are an example of the hard-shelled arthropod class that also includes crabs and shrimps.

clue.text: Discipline needed by one in actors' entrance

indicators.note: in places the numeral for one inside the following words

parts.note: the cast is the troupe of actors in a play
a gate is an entrance
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone has to keep order at the stage door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'actors' entrance' reads as a stage door, but each word gives its own piece, and 'in' puts the one between them.
explanation.definitionFit: To discipline someone is to reprimand or punish them severely, a verb sense.

clue.text: Overrule check on job centre

parts.note: to vet is to check

indicators.note: centre takes the middle letter of job

explanation.surface: Someone blocks an inspection at the employment office.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'job centre' is a British government employment office; here it means only the middle letter of job.
explanation.definitionFit: A veto is the power to reject or block a decision.

clue.text: Unfortunately turned up to note there was sausage

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means the word for unfortunately is read from bottom to top

parts.note: alas is an exclamation meaning unfortunately
mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Sadly, someone arrived to find only sausage on offer.
explanation.definitionFit: Salami is a cured, highly seasoned Italian type of sausage.

clue.text: Soldiers sin in the ranks

indicators.note: in puts the word for sin inside the word for ranks

parts.note: tiers are rows or ranks
to err is to sin

explanation.surface: There is wrongdoing among the military rank and file.
explanation.walkthrough: Terriers is British slang for members of the Territorial Army, its volunteer reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of Britain's volunteer reserve army are nicknamed after the dog breed.

clue.text: Eager to agree on such a construction

definitions.text: Eager to agree on such a construction

parts.words: Eager to agree on such a construction
parts.note: the word eager, once its letters are rearranged, becomes agree: the clue describes that wordplay device itself

explanation.surface: Someone keen to reach consensus about a building project.
explanation.definitionFit: The letters of eager reshuffled spell agree, the very device of rearranged letters.

clue.text: The girl who's crazy about one?

indicators.note: about means the word for crazy goes around the numeral

parts.note: mad means crazy
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A girl infatuated with someone special.
explanation.definitionFit: A maid is an old or poetic word for a young woman.

clue.text: Mean to assert maturity

parts.note: to aver is to assert
age is maturity, coming of age

explanation.surface: Someone intends to claim they have grown up.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean is the arithmetical middle value of a set of figures.

clue.text: Temporary move by force?

explanation.surface: A provisional relocation carried out by the police.
explanation.definitionFit: Makeshift means improvised as a stopgap; read as make shift, it is to force something to move.

clue.text: Delighted with working atmosphere

parts.note: on means working, as a machine that is on
air is the atmosphere

explanation.surface: Someone is thrilled with the mood at the office.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on 'walking on air', meaning delighted.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on air evokes the idiom of walking on air, elated and happy.

clue.text: Early life form originally revealed in soft rock

indicators.note: in places the first letter inside the word for soft rock

parts.note: lava is molten, soft rock

indicators.note: originally takes the first letter of revealed

explanation.surface: A primitive organism has been uncovered in a soft stone formation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soft rock' looks like music, but it is LAVA, with R (from 'originally revealed') inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A larva is the young stage of an insect before metamorphosis.

clue.text: Stone cottage in France — managed to get in!

indicators.note: to get in means the word for managed is put inside the French cottage

parts.note: a gite is a French holiday cottage
ran means managed

explanation.surface: Someone succeeds in entering a stone-built French cottage.
explanation.definitionFit: Granite is a hard igneous rock used in building.

clue.text: Speak with clarity, but then make a joint!

explanation.surface: Speak clearly first, and then roll a cannabis cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: To articulate is to pronounce distinctly; as a verb it also means to connect by a flexible hinge.

clue.text: A compiler who's quick to find high society?

definitions.note: the definition names the fashionable set; the answer is one of its members

parts.note: jet suggests speed, as in jet-propelled
a setter is the compiler of a crossword

explanation.surface: A crossword compiler who travels fast to reach the elite.
explanation.walkthrough: Setter is the usual word for a crossword compiler.
explanation.definitionFit: A wealthy traveller of the fashionable international set belongs to the glamorous elite.

clue.text: Talks given by engineers with illustrations

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers of the British Army
presentations are talks given to an audience

explanation.surface: Engineers give lectures with diagrams.
explanation.definitionFit: Representations are depictions or pictures of something.

clue.text: More than one piggy in the middle!

definitions.text: More than one piggy in the middle!

parts.words: More than one piggy in the middle!
parts.note: the playground game becomes a picture of selfish drivers hogging the centre of the carriageway

explanation.surface: Several children are stuck as piggy in the middle in the playground game.
explanation.definitionFit: Inconsiderate motorists who hog the centre of the road are nicknamed after greedy pigs.

clue.text: Exceed one's limit concerning tie

parts.note: over means concerning, as in a row over money
a draw is a tied game

explanation.surface: Someone overspends while arguing about a necktie.
explanation.definitionFit: To overdraw is to take more from a bank account than it holds.

clue.text: Sums of money a horse finally loses

parts.note: a mount is a horse for riding

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of loses

explanation.surface: A gambler counts the cash lost when a horse is beaten.
explanation.definitionFit: Amounts are quantities or totals, especially of cash.

clue.text: Soldiers with American lawyer before home rule

parts.note: OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers
DA is a district attorney, a US prosecutor
in means at home

explanation.surface: Troops and a US attorney argue for self-government.
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to decree or order officially.

clue.text: The belief that there's constant energy absorbed by snooker ball

parts.note: c is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light

indicators.note: absorbed by puts the symbol for energy inside the snooker ball

parts.note: red is one of the snooker balls
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A conviction that a snooker ball soaks up endless energy.
explanation.walkthrough: Snooker is a cue game whose fifteen red balls are potted between colours.
explanation.definitionFit: A creed is a system of religious or other faith.

clue.text: Humorously sarcastic study from poet

parts.note: dry humour is understated and sarcastic
a den is a private study

explanation.surface: A wry piece of research about a poet.
explanation.walkthrough: John Dryden was a 17th-century English poet laureate.
explanation.definitionFit: John Dryden was an English Restoration writer of verse and satire.

clue.text: Some call him a military man who leads prayers

indicators.note: some takes just part of the following words

explanation.surface: Some call a prayer leader a soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' signals a hidden word: it runs across hIM A Military.
explanation.definitionFit: An imam leads communal worship in a mosque.

clue.text: Prevaricate over hotel boundary

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
an edge is a boundary

explanation.surface: Someone is evasive about the hotel's property line.
explanation.definitionFit: To hedge is to avoid committing oneself, dodging a straight answer.

clue.text: Test once in the morning

parts.note: ex means former, once
am means morning, ante meridiem

explanation.surface: A test that used to be held before noon.
explanation.definitionFit: An exam is a formal assessment of knowledge.

clue.text: What one might do with washing lines after having fallen

definitions.text: What one might do with washing

indicators.note: after places the word for lines behind the word for fallen

parts.note: tumbled means having fallen
RY is railway, railway lines

explanation.surface: Laundry on a washing line has blown down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'washing lines' reads as one phrase, but 'lines' gives RY (railway) and the definition ends at 'washing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Laundry is dried in a rotating heated drum machine.

clue.text: Pull a face, seeing depressing card

parts.note: grim means depressing
an ace is a playing card

explanation.surface: A card player scowls on being dealt a bad hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A grimace is a twisted facial expression of pain or disgust.

clue.text: Somehow, he meant to have gas

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters are arranged in some other way

explanation.surface: He somehow intended to have gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somehow' signals an anagram of HE MEANT.
explanation.definitionFit: Methane is a flammable hydrocarbon, the main part of natural fuel.
